outcome: diffusion along the perivascular space (ALPS) index
cohort: The study included 418 neonates, comprising 92 preterm neonates (57 males) and 326 term neonates (175 males), sourced from the Developing Human Connectome Project.
finding: Preterm neonates exhibited lower ALPS indices compared to term neonates, and the ALPS index positively correlated with postmenstrual age and gestational age, with preterm birth significantly moderating the relationship between ALPS index and postmenstrual age.
cross-section timing: At the time of MRI, during the neonatal period
gest_age: Measured as gestational age (GA) and postmenstrual age (PMA) at MRI for both preterm and term neonates
